```sql
SELECT SUM(t.amnt) AS total_paid
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id AND d.typ = 'OWNER'
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE c.clnt_id = 617
  AND t.dt >= '1998-01-01' AND t.dt < '1999-01-01'
```

通过 `clnt → dsp → acct → trns` 链取客户 617 名下账户在 1998 年的全部交易金额求和。
